top_choice_rationale: P001 recognises one specific, mature discovery line: human GLP-1 physiology (Holst), identification and synthesis of the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide (Mojsov), and proglucagon-derived peptide biology (Drucker). Its clinical consequence is confirmed in independent randomized trials on glycaemia, body weight, and cardiovascular and renal outcomes. The three-name allocation credits the discovery line without turning it into a drug-development prize, and a physiology-and-active-peptide citation keeps the scope narrow. Habener's absence, Mojsov's contested priority and Knudsen's exclusion are real costs, but none is strong enough to justify no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; co-authored the 2016 Science spatial transcriptomics paper and has eight recorded co-authored works with Rickard Sandberg, but no connection to Drucker, Holst or Mojsov
